## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. Distinguish offline tests from
live SC2 checks, and record failed attempts or untested platforms.

- [ ] Documentation and examples match the final behavior.
- [ ] Relevant offline checks pass.
- [ ] Native changes retain build guards, independent ownership and cleanup.
- [ ] Generated reports, replays and compiled helpers are excluded from the change.

For documentation-only changes, mark native checks as not applicable.
